Data Analyst – Entry Level
Position Description
Are you passionate about uncovering insights that drive smarter decisions and help organizations solve real world problems? Do you enjoy working with data, collaborating with teams, and using analytics and AI enabled tools to turn information into meaningful outcomes?
If so, CGI offers a place where you can grow your career, build your skills, and make a real impact from day one.
As an Entry Level Data Analyst, you’ll work with cross functional teams to prepare, analyze, and interpret data that shapes business decisions and solutions. You’ll gain hands on experience with modern analytics tools and technology enabled workflows, building strong foundations in data analysis, visualization, problem solving, and responsible data practices.
Applications are open until February 26th, 2027.
Position is in Houston, TX in a hybrid working model
Your future duties and responsibilities
How You’ll Make an Impact
• Develop a strong understanding of your client’s industry, organization, customers, and business objectives.
• Build trusted relationships with clients and teammates by asking thoughtful questions, actively listening, and clarifying business needs.
• Collaborate with clients and cross-functional teams to translate business questions and needs into analytical approaches and solutions.
• Apply foundational analytical techniques to identify trends, compare results, test assumptions and draw meaningful conclusions from data.
• Collect, prepare, analyze and interpret data to identify trends, patterns, and insights that help answer client questions and inform decisions.
• Support the development of reports, dashboards, visualizations, and other data drive solutions that turn information into meaningful insights.
• Communicate findings and insights clearly through data storytelling and visualizations that technical and non-technical audiences can understand.
• Use modern and AI‑enabled tools to support data preparation, exploration, analysis, visualization, and insight generation.
• Apply responsible AI practices by considering privacy, security, data quality, transparency, and appropriate human oversight when using AI-enabled tools
• Support data quality, validation, documentation, testing and continuous improvement activities throughout the project life cycle.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role
What You’ll Bring
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
• Authorization to work in the United States on a permanent basis without current or future employer sponsorship. Certain positions may also require U.S. Citizenship and/or the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance based on client or government requirements.
• Curiosity, professionalism, and a strong desire for continuous learning.
• Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with comfort navigating ambiguity and complex information.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify and explain complex ideas.
• Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with fast-paced cross functional teams.
• Foundational proficiency of data analysis concepts and techniques, including data preparation, exploration, visualization and interpretation.
• Foundational proficiency to data analysis tools and technologies such as SQL, data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI or Tableau), and/or programming languages used for data analysis (e.g., Python or R).
• Exposure to data analysis through coursework, internships, research or personal projects is preferred but not required.
• Foundational understanding of development data/AI engineering and analysis concepts and technologies, such as object-oriented programming, artificial intelligence and machine learning, APIs, testing version control and the software development lifecycle
• Interest in learning and responsibly using AI-enabled tools, analytics platforms, and modern data technologies to support data-driven decision making.

Job Description  
  
Insight Global is seeking a Data Analyst to support the Global Operations organization by applying strong analytical, data, and systems expertise to advance a global clean-data initiative. The role focuses on improving the quality, consistency, and structure of operational data across platforms—most notably within ServiceNow and related operational systems.  
  
Analysts will analyze current data and processes, design future-state data models and flows, and help implement changes that strengthen operational reporting, automation, and decision-making. The large majority of this role is centralized around looking at the existing data footprint across multiple systems and owning the clean up and remediation efforts across the systems and ensuring data meets existing governance standards.  
  
Responsibilities include:  
\- Analyze current-state data flows, system dependencies, and operational processes that impact data accuracy.  
\- Design improved or future-state data structures, mappings, and workflows in support of global clean-data efforts.  
\- Support data cleansing activities, normalization efforts, and large-scale data remediation projects.  
\- Prepare and execute data-related test cases, queries, and validation scripts for UAT cycles.  
\- Collaborate with system owners to ensure data updates are implemented correctly and sustainably.  
\- Develop and maintain data dictionaries, standards, and governance documentation.  
\- Identify risks across people, process, data, and systems related to data quality or change impacts.

OHS Southwest Region GOH is a small management consulting firm supporting the federal government since 1997 ( www.gohnow.com ). We are seeking an energetic new team member experienced in Federal grants management to support our Office of Head Start client. GOH is recruiting in anticipation of potential future openings that are subject to final approval and funding. No guarantee of position availability can be made at this time; however, candidate identification and preliminary interviews are being conducted to support timely hiring should authorization be granted. The successful candidate will have a proven track record of leading grants management data analysis and reporting tasks, as well as serving as the primary data / system point of contact between the functional and technical teams. The successful candidate will be able to conduct complex data collection and analysis while integrating data from multiple sources into a streamlined workflow. You must prepare reports, presentations, trend identification, develop dashboards, and provide high-quality data analyses to support decision-making and process improvements. You must assist with building, maintaining, and testing databases and IT infrastructure and consolidating data from multiple sources so analysts and team members may easily access and interpret data reliably. Additional consideration for the candidate with analytical visualization, interactive designs, and data story telling experience. SMU’s relationship with Dallas – the dynamic center of one of the nation’s fastest-growing regions – offers unique learning, research, social and career opportunities that provide a launch pad for global impact.
SMU is nonsectarian in its teaching and committed to academic freedom and open inquiry.
About the Department:
The Office of Institutional Insights and Intelligence (OIII) serves as the University’s centralized Decision Support and Institutional Research function, integrating institutional research, enterprise data governance, data management, and advanced analytics, including predictive modeling and artificial intelligence. Working collaboratively with stakeholders across the University, OIII transforms trusted institutional data into actionable intelligence and forward-looking insights that support strategic planning, institutional priorities, and informed decision-making.
Through integrated data, standardized business definitions, and advanced analytical capabilities, OIII strengthens institutional effectiveness, supports student success, and advances the University’s accountability, accreditation, and external reporting responsibilities.
About the Position:
This role is an on-campus, in-person position.
The BI Data Analyst transforms institutional data into trusted analyses, business intelligence products, and evidence-based insights supporting University planning, operations, accountability, and decision support.
Analysts work across academic and administrative domains, mining data from source systems, combining data analysis, visualization, data quality, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration.
Within assigned work, BI Data Analysts exercise initiative and technical judgment to select methods, identify risks, recommend approaches, and deliver results.
Job level and compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.
Essential Functions:

• Institutional Analytics & Decision Support
• Mine for and Analyze institutional data to answer institutional planning, operational, strategic, and compliance questions.

• Synthesize information across sources to identify trends, relationships, anomalies, risks, and opportunities; develop evidence-based observations and recommendations for further inquiry.

• Business Intelligence, Visualization & Communication
• Design, maintain, and improve reports, dashboards, visualizations, KPI products, and executive or Board-ready analytical materials.

• Communicate analytical findings, assumptions, and limitations clearly through appropriate visual and narrative formats.

• Data Preparation & Reusable Analytics
• Mine, query, combine, transform, and document data from enterprise systems, warehouses, and other approved sources.

• Develop reusable queries, analytical datasets, and semantic or data models; coordinate with technical teams to support sustainable and traceable products.

• Perform analytics engineering to design, develop, and maintain governed, reusable datasets within the enterprise data warehouse, using medallion architecture, SQL, dbt, GitHub, and related tools to ensure data quality, consistency, traceability, and scalability.

• Data Quality, Governance & Documentation
• Apply approved definitions, business rules, data governance, privacy, security, and appropriate-use requirements.

• Validate and reconcile results, investigate discrepancies, document sources and methods, and raise recurring quality or process issues for resolution with appropriate owners.

• Stakeholder Partnership & Consultation
• As assigned, consult with academic and administrative stakeholders to understand business processes, clarify questions, and translate needs into analytical requirements.

• Collaborate with Data Stewards, OIT, institutional research colleagues, and other partners on approved cross-functional work.

• Continuous Improvement & Professional Practice
• Maintain relevant BI, institutional research, analytics, and governance knowledge; improve repeatability, usability, and sustainability of analytical products.

• Contribute to shared standards, documentation, knowledge transfer, and cross-training.

• Occasional evening and weekend work may be required during critical times.

Education and Experience:
Baccalaureate (bachelor's) degree and five (5) years of work experience conducting complex quantitative and qualitative analyses is required.
